scientific_limitations: Exactly three equal instantaneous effective-rainfall inputs, equally spaced, routed through three identical linear reservoirs. Historical sources from 1957 and February 1998 lack verified first-public calendar days; 2004-04-15 is the earliest independently verified day-resolved primary-model motivating-source publication. This date is not an attribution of origination. No claim for finite-duration events, noisy peak identification, or nonlinear infiltration. Earlier related modal-geometry work may cover some consequence and independent assessment has not been performed.
